That work drives a refrigerator which removes \(250\,\mathrm{J}\) from a cold reservoir. Find the refrigerator's hot-side transfer and the composite external effect.

Equation \([1]\) gives \(W=400\,\mathrm{J}\). Work is internal to the combination. Final result: the sole external effect is transfer of \(250\,\mathrm{J}\) from cold to hot, a Clausius violation.

Final answer:
The sole external effect is transfer of \(250\,\mathrm{J}\) from cold to hot, a Clausius violation.
